notes: Clean one-decoy-per-constraint design: each wrong venue fails exactly one constraint, which is fair and readable.

Mina's vegetarianism is never stated outright; it is inferred from 'i can always just get fries', 'one you can actually eat' and 'a veggie patty'. Fair at level_03 but a player could read it as a preference (one star) rather than a strict diet (deal-breaker). Either way the pick is the same.
Brisket Box's beef-fat fries review is a nice touch: it closes the 'she can just get fries' loophole.
No budget is stated in the chat; all venues are $, so price never matters here.
'No long sit-down' is stated plainly by Liam, which makes the speed constraint fairly obvious.
